nodes.title: The underworks begin to sing

beats.text: You stand beneath the Glasswell habitat where the coolant gutters hum like a choir, and the sealed maintenance iris begins answering a pulse no apprentice is supposed to hear.

choices.label: Trace the pulse through the coolant gutters
Report the waking iris to the shift matron
Hide your toolmark before anyone sees it

memory_intents.summary: The player heard the sealed Glasswell iris answer an unauthorized pulse.

nodes.writer_notes: Keep the source lore as influence only; do not import canon names or events.

beats.text: The pulse moves with the patience of a machine pretending to be alive, leaving bright mineral frost where your fingers nearly touch the pipe.

nodes.title: The rule has a human voice

beats.text: The shift matron listens without surprise, then asks which part of the sound felt like a command and which part felt like an invitation.
Your toolmark darkens under your sleeve, warmed by the same pulse, and the hidden stain feels less like evidence than a choice you already made.
